items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The guard is a two-line `if not ...is_cached(rel_obj):` that matches the surrounding style and needs no comment. Existing comments are kept.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: The fix reuses the existing is_cached API in three sibling prefetch methods. It is the same minimal guard in each place, with no new bookkeeping and no dead code.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Only adds a conditional guard: no exception handling, magic constants or resource handling. Hidden tests pass (F2P 1/1, P2P 85/85).

items.name: Guard is conditional and covers the one-to-one variant
items.name_zh: 仅在已缓存时跳过回填，并考虑一对一情形
items.evidence: The reverse-FK path has `if not self.field.is_cached(rel_obj):`. The same guard is added to ReverseOneToOneDescriptor and ForwardManyToOneDescriptor. Reverse caching still happens when the child isn't cached.
